content.comment_body: Hello forum members, I am new here and have a question regarding an issue with [product_name] (latest version) and a 32GB FAT32 SD card. Initially, I was able to download several test versions of a project over the network without issues. I then spent considerable time improving the project. Unfortunately, my PC's hard drive encountered a problem and it seemed I had lost the project. Using recovery software, I managed to restore all files and could open the recovered project in [product_name] without issues, but was unable to download it to the device anymore. Each attempt results in the error message '[Download Failed! Invalid project]'. Searching the forum didn't turn up any solutions. Since it's not possible to open multiple instances of [product_name], I couldn't copy elements between projects. So, I tried deploying the recovered project to the SD card, which worked fine and all elements functioned as expected. Next, I attempted to upload the project from the device to the PC as a new project. That worked, but trying to download from the PC to the device triggered the same error again. Because the device is to be installed remotely with internet access, it's necessary to be able to download updates, and I've put so much effort into the project that I don't want to start over. Any help would be appreciated. Thanks in advance! [user_name] Note: Network communication between PC and the device works flawlessly for both [product_name] and other relevant tools.
Could you please upload your project as a ZIP file?
You sent your project to me via private message. Unfortunately, I can't assist. Your project appears to be damaged. Please consider starting a support request.

Hello [user_name], Thank you for your response. It's unfortunate that the project is damaged. You suggested opening a support request; does this require a paid agreement to proceed? Kind regards, [user_name]
I can't confirm for certain, but typically the first support request is free. It depends how much support will be able to assist, but I would give it a try.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering a critical issue when attempting to download a recovered project to their device after a hard drive failure and file recovery. Although the project opens in the editor and can be deployed successfully to an SD card, a '[Download Failed! Invalid project]' error appears when downloading to the device, disrupting workflow and risking significant loss of invested effort. The editor does not detect corruption until deployment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects robust project recovery, editing, and deployment capabilities in [product_name], hoping to transfer recovered projects to devices without loss. They seek assurance of a reliable workflow for managing recovered files and hope their invested work is not wasted.
